messages:
Aisha (CSM): quick sync — Acme Labs preview intake. finalizing seat count + data access. can we confirm who needs SSO and who needs API keys?
Marco (Account Exec): Jules said 3 seats. two engineers + a product lead. SSO for product lead, API keys for the engineers.
Jules (Acme Labs): yes that matches. engineers are Maya and Tom, product lead is Sara. when's the enablement session?
Aisha (CSM): aiming for next Wed 11am PT. does that work for you? we'll cover usage patterns, billing expectations, and prompt safety guide.
Priya (PM): adding canary cohort runbook to the agenda — quick demo of the streaming behavior and browse features. want to reserve 30m for feedback capture so we can log ask/bugs.
Rohit (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a minimal prompt set and a small dataset to demo prefix caching. sharing this snippet for dataset upload command:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/datasets -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -F 'file=@sample.json' -F 'name=acme_preview_sample'
```
Aisha (CSM): Jules — do you have a staging VPC or should we provision a temporary private endpoint?
Jules (Acme Labs): staging exists but it's behind a strict firewall, would prefer a temporary private endpoint. can we get a timeline?
onboarding-bot: A private endpoint provisioning request has been submitted (req-99218). estimated ETA 2 business days.
Marco (Account Exec): note: renewal conversation in 3 months. if onboarding slips past our internal timeline there's a risk they downgrade priority. want to make the first 2 weeks feel "productive" — fast wins.
Aisha (CSM): agreed. action items: (1) Rohit to share prompt set + quickstart docs by EOD Friday; (2) infra team to confirm private endpoint by Thu; (3) schedule Wed 11am PT enablement meeting — calendar invite will include Recording + feedback form.
Rohit (Solutions Eng): will upload prompts and a troubleshooting checklist. also adding a short runbook for token-cost guardrails.
Priya (PM): can we add a one-question NPS-style pulse at the end of the session? quick thumbs up/down works best.
Jules (Acme Labs): thumbs up. also would like to surface a single integration blocker: our telemetry uses a custom header pattern. Rohit, can you confirm header passthrough support?
Rohit (Solutions Eng): yes, we support passthrough X-Custom-* headers. will include example in the docs.
Aisha (CSM): perfect. I'll send a pre-read and attendee list. if anything changes ping me here and I'll triage. :raised_hands: 
Marco (Account Exec): pinging legal to speed up the DPA sign — @Jules once DPA is in place we'll be green across compliance checklist.
Jules (Acme Labs): noted, legal is already on it. thanks everyone.
Aisha (CSM): final note: we'll run a 2-week feedback loop after enablement — quick async survey on day 3 and day 14 to capture early regressions and adoption blockers. Rohit/Priya we'll attach the eval prompt set to each survey.
Priya (PM): logging that as "preview-feedback-1" in our tracker. will send meeting agenda before EOD Monday.
Aisha (CSM): thanks all — closing the thread for now. ping if blockers show up. :white_check_mark:
